candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on /v1/checkout. Traces show every checkout correlation failing with an upstream 500 from order:8000, and gateway metrics show 16 502s vs 2.7 200s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Order-side logs and dependency metrics were not admitted, so the specific order-internal failure (db, redis, payment) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show order returning 500 to gateway checkout, producing 502s at the gateway. This bounds the fault to the order service path, but the underlying order-internal cause is not established by admitted evidence, so only the http-500 candidate is offered.
missing_evidence: Order service logs/errors explaining the 500 on POST /v1/orders
Order dependency operation metrics (postgresql, payment, inventory) to rule out db-pool-exhaustion or redis-timeout
